basic_info.description: Welcome to your San Francisco sweet spot: a stylish loft condo with the kind of perks that make city living not just easy but enviable.  Step inside and you'll find soaring ceilings, custom shelving that actually makes sense, and sleek modern appliances that can handle both your Sunday farmer's market haul and your late-night Postmates order.    But the real magic is outdoors: a spacious private patio, perfect for morning coffee, a little container gardening, or hosting friends who won't stop asking, "Wait, you have THIS much outdoor space in the city?"    Parking? Not one, but two coveted spots in one of San Francisco's most gracious garages (yes, "gracious" and "garage" can exist in the same sentence). Add in abundant storage both in the unit and garage, and you've got room for bikes, boards, skis, and all the toys of city-adjacent adventuring.    Location doesn't get better: steps to the Panhandle, a quick stroll to Golden Gate Park, and within walking distance to some of the city's best restaurants, cafes, and nightlife.    You'll also appreciate the modern security and access features, because peace of mind should be part of the package.    This is San Francisco living done right: walkable, stylish, practical, and just the right amount of brag-worthy.
